apps.name: PIVOT
apps.subtitle: Theme park companion
apps.localizedDescription: Park wait times, ride status, weather observations, planning, shows and Live Activities.
apps.versionDescription: Saved lightning observations now expire and clearly show saved or unavailable data. Empty or unhealthy ride feeds no longer report that all rides are clear. Failed refresh status stays saved when switching parks, and delayed GPS results no longer override manual park choices. Existing 1.14 features, saved-data keys and the Live Activity extension are preserved. Native update only; backend changes are separate.
